title: OEWN Round 2 — Rewritten Learning Content
scope_note_zh: 本文件是独立的学习释义补充稿。它不改 Round 2 审核决定、现有主义项 ID、pilot 词条或 OEWN 原始数据。没有对应 OEWN 候选的补充义项使用 null，不编造义项 ID。

entries.definition_en: Used before a singular countable noun when referring to one person or thing that is not already known or identified.
entries.gloss_zh: 不定冠词：一个；某个（用于不特指的人或物）
entries.usage_note_zh: 用于可数名词单数前；元音音素开头时通常用 an。

entries.definition_en: Inside a place, container, or area; also used for something happening during a period of time.
entries.usage_note_zh: 常见于 in a room、in a box、in July、in the morning。

entries.definition_en: Used to refer to a male person or animal already mentioned or understood.
entries.usage_note_zh: 通常作主语。

entries.definition_en: Touching or supported by a surface; also used before a day or date.
entries.usage_note_zh: 常见于 on the table、on Monday、on June 5。

entries.definition_en: The person who is speaking or writing, when that person is the subject of a sentence.
entries.usage_note_zh: 英语中 I 始终大写。

entries.definition_en: In the role or function of; during the time that or because; used in as…as to compare two things as equal in a quality.
entries.usage_note_zh: 常见结构：work as a teacher；as I was leaving；as tall as。

entries.definition_en: Used for a particular place or point in time.
entries.gloss_zh: 在（某个地点或具体时刻）
entries.usage_note_zh: 常见于 at the door、at school、at 6 o’clock。

entries.definition_en: Introduces a statement that contrasts with what was just said.
entries.usage_note_zh: 连接意思相反或出乎预期的内容。

entries.definition_en: Shows who performs an action; means near or beside; or tells how something is done.
entries.usage_note_zh: 被动句中可引出动作执行者；也可表示方式，如 by bus。

entries.definition_en: Used with a verb to talk about the future, make a prediction, or express willingness or a decision.
entries.usage_note_zh: 后接动词原形。

entries.definition_en: Used to say that someone is able to do something, knows how to do it, or has permission to do it.
entries.usage_note_zh: 后接动词原形；也常用于请求或给予许可。

entries.definition_en: Higher than something, sometimes with no contact; from one side to the other; or more than a stated amount.
entries.usage_note_zh: 具体含义由位置、移动或数量语境决定。

entries.definition_en: Later than a particular time, event, or action.
entries.usage_note_zh: 后面可接名词、时间表达或完整从句。

entries.definition_en: Used to say that something is possible, or to ask for or give permission.
entries.usage_note_zh: 后接动词原形；表示许可时语气通常较正式。

entries.definition_en: Earlier than a particular time, event, or action.
entries.usage_note_zh: 后面可接名词、时间表达或完整从句。

entries.definition_en: From one side or end of something to the other, often by going inside it; also by means of something.
entries.usage_note_zh: 可表示穿过空间，也可表示通过某种方式或途径。

entries.definition_en: In the space or period separating two people, things, places, or points.
entries.usage_note_zh: 常用于 between A and B。

entries.definition_en: Used to ask about or explain the reason for something.
entries.usage_note_zh: 可用于直接提问，也可引导间接疑问句。

entries.definition_en: Used to say that something is possible but uncertain; also used to make a suggestion or request more tentative.
entries.usage_note_zh: 后接动词原形；语气常比 may 更不确定或更委婉。

entries.definition_en: Used to say that something is necessary or required, or to express a strong belief that something is true.
entries.usage_note_zh: 后接动词原形；具体是义务还是推断取决于语境。

entries.definition_en: Below or covered by something; also less than a stated age, amount, or limit.
entries.usage_note_zh: 常见于 under the bed、under 18、under $20。

entries.definition_en: Inside the limits of a place, period of time, or amount.
entries.usage_note_zh: 常见于 within the city、within a week、within budget。

entries.definition_en: From one side of something to the other, or on the opposite side.
entries.usage_note_zh: 可表示穿越范围，也可表示位于另一侧。

entries.definition_en: Following the length or direction of something, or at a point on it.
entries.usage_note_zh: 常见于 along the road、along the river。

entries.definition_en: At or to a higher position or level than something; also more than a stated number or amount.
entries.usage_note_zh: 常用于位置、等级、数值或前文提及的内容。

entries.definition_en: At or toward the back of someone or something; also later or less advanced than expected.
entries.usage_note_zh: 可表示空间位置，也可表示进度落后。

entries.definition_en: At or to a lower level or position than something; also less than a stated amount or standard.
entries.usage_note_zh: 常见于 below the surface、below average、below zero。

entries.definition_en: Without being stopped or affected by something; in spite of it.
entries.usage_note_zh: 后接名词、代词或动名词；完整句子通常用 despite the fact that。

entries.definition_en: On or to the farther side of something; more than, or outside the limits of something.
entries.usage_note_zh: 可表示空间、范围、能力或理解上的超出。

entries.definition_en: Not including a person or thing; apart from that person or thing.
entries.usage_note_zh: 表示把某人或某物从整体中排除。

entries.definition_en: In every part of a place, or during the whole of a period of time.
entries.usage_note_zh: 可表示空间范围，也可表示整个时间段。

entries.definition_en: A thing that belongs to or is associated with the speaker; used without a following noun.
entries.usage_note_zh: mine 可独立使用；名词前用 my。

entries.definition_en: An informal way to say yes or to show agreement.
entries.usage_note_zh: 比 yes 更口语化。

entries.definition_en: No person; not anyone.
entries.usage_note_zh: 作主语时通常搭配单数动词。

entries.definition_en: Money, property, or another valuable item owned by a person or organization.
entries.usage_note_zh: 财务语境中可指现金、房产、设备等有价值的所有物。

entries.definition_en: Up to the time when something happens; until.
entries.usage_note_zh: 常用于时间表达；语体较口语，意思与 until 相同。

entries.definition_en: A mobile phone.
entries.usage_note_zh: 美式英语通常说 cell phone 或 cellphone。

entries.definition_en: In some religions, the place where the souls of wicked people are believed to go after death.
entries.usage_note_zh: 这是宗教义；hell 也常用于非宗教的强烈表达。

entries.definition_en: Forward or outward from a starting point; in current English, most often used in set phrases.
entries.usage_note_zh: 单独使用偏正式或文学语体。常见搭配：and so forth（等等）；back and forth（来回）。

entries.definition_en: In or to a lower position than something; directly under it.
entries.usage_note_zh: 语体较正式；日常对话中常用 under。

entries.definition_en: A story, often about imaginary or traditional events.
entries.gloss_zh: 故事；传说（常涉及虚构或传统故事）
entries.usage_note_zh: 比 story 更常见于文学表达或固定搭配；不表示所有 tale 都一定是虚构的。

entries.definition_en: In, at, or to any place; no matter where.
entries.gloss_zh: 无论在哪里；无论到哪里
entries.usage_note_zh: 常引导表示地点的从句。

entries.definition_en: A group of related pages on the internet, usually available under one web address and maintained by a person or organization.
entries.gloss_zh: 网站：通过同一网址访问的一组相关网页
entries.usage_note_zh: 网站是网页内容的集合，不是提供网页的服务器。

entries.definition_en: Next to or at the side of something; also together with someone or something.
entries.usage_note_zh: 可表示并列的位置，也可表示共同参与。

entries.definition_en: In a satisfactory way or well enough; also used informally to say that something is acceptable or to agree.
entries.usage_note_zh: alright 是 all right 的非正式拼写形式；正式写作中通常使用 all right。
